response_demand: recognition|cued-recall through choice and literal gaps
attempt_policy: nonpunitive; no attempt count persisted; retry remains learner-controlled
feedback_policy: correctness plus authored canonical explanation; local option feedback when present
consequence_policy: none or structural-progress; no grade, ranking or mastery inference
telemetry_policy: no openings, time, attempts, correctness, errors or result history
authority_model: learner controls study; author controls content; publication remains explicit
notes: Preserve as coherent first profile, not universal default.

context: personal study with stronger completion criterion
response_demand: selected or constructed responses appropriate to objective
attempt_policy: unlimited or fixed-n with staged support; mastery based on latest valid evidence
reveal_policy: after learner request or attempt threshold
feedback_policy: result then hint/elaboration; correct answer after threshold; persistent explanation
consequence_policy: mastery-gate for local progression only; no external grade
telemetry_policy: none by default; optional personal history under explicit choice
authority_model: learner preference over author defaults except structural/safety constraints
notes: Useful alternative absent from AraLearn; progression details continue in P2.

attempt_policy: fixed-n or until-correct according to task; equivalent-item retry supported
feedback_policy: actionable elaboration; error-specific where valid; teacher/human comment for open work
consequence_policy: low-stakes score optional; no public ranking; grade contribution explicit
telemetry_policy: minimum protocol-approved events; learner and teacher visibility separated
authority_model: institution/course policy controls; accessibility override and consent precede ordinary settings
notes: Grade contribution is allowed but not assumed to cause learning.

context: consequential assessment separated from ordinary study
response_demand: response form chosen for construct and measurement quality
attempt_policy: usually one or tightly controlled attempts; retake policy separate
feedback_policy: validity and submission confirmation during assessment; result/feedback after release as policy allows
telemetry_policy: auditable events only under legal policy, minimization and retention
authority_model: institution controls within law; accommodations and due process override; learner cannot alter scoring
notes: Not a baseline study profile. Probabilistic assistance cannot be sole final authority.

response_demand: locked according to construct and comparison
attempt_policy: locked by protocol within consent; same/equivalent item specified
feedback_policy: content, timing and persistence fixed by condition
consequence_policy: normally none or low consequence; participant compensation and course grade kept separate where possible
telemetry_policy: only predeclared events; pseudonymization, withdrawal and retention required
notes: Any condition that blocks a required accommodation needs ethical alternative or exclusion rationale.

context: applies to personal, course, summative or research profiles
response_demand: equivalent action/expression or documented construct modification
attempt_policy: may extend attempts or time where needed
reveal_policy: must preserve access to correction; timing adjusted only when construct requires
feedback_policy: accessible instructions, status, error correction and equivalent modalities
consequence_policy: no penalty solely for approved accommodation
telemetry_policy: accommodation data protected; no profiling by default
authority_model: legal/accessibility authority precedes course, protocol and learner preference conflicts
notes: Not a separate pedagogy. It modifies barriers and records construct impact.
